base_value_source: Q3 FY26 earnings call transcript, prepared remarks (CFO Bealer), Jul 9 2026; corroborated by Estimates Report.xls Guidance tab, entry dated 2026-07-09 (earnings/04_guidance-consensus.md §2)
base_period: FY2026 (guidance, full year ending on or about Aug 29, 2026)
revenue_period: FY2026 (guidance, full year ending on or about Aug 29, 2026)

sensitivities.label: Quest brand YoY net-sales growth rate
sensitivities.unit: pp (percentage points of YoY revenue growth)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes Quest's incremental revenue flows through at the CONSOLIDATED FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin (19.2%), because no brand-level margin is disclosed under ASC 280 single-segment reporting. If Quest's true margin differs from the consolidated blend, actual flow-through will differ; not tested at moves outside the -5 to +8pp range shown in §2.
sensitivities.source: Derived by agent from FY2025 10-K, Note 15 (Quest = 59.5% of FY2025 net sales); FQ3 FY26 10-Q, Note 12 and Q3 FY26 earnings call, Jul 9 2026 (Quest = 63.7% of 9-month FY26 net sales, +1.1% YoY in FQ3 FY26); earnings/01_historical-financials.md §4 (FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin 19.2%, $278.2M/$1,450.9M)

sensitivities.label: Atkins brand YoY net-sales growth rate
sensitivities.unit: pp (percentage points of YoY revenue growth)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes Atkins's incremental revenue flows through at the CONSOLIDATED FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin (19.2%), because no brand-level margin is disclosed under ASC 280 single-segment reporting. Atkins's true margin may differ; the fixed-cost base behind Atkins's own declining revenue is not disclosed separately (operating-deleverage risk, see §6 of the markdown report).
sensitivities.source: Derived by agent from Q3 FY26 earnings call, Jul 9 2026, CEO prepared remarks (Atkins = 24.9% of 9-month FY26 net sales, FQ3 FY26 YoY decline -24.6%); FY2025 10-K, Item 1A, p.24 (Walmart cut Atkins assortment in FY2025); earnings/01_historical-financials.md §4 (FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin 19.2%)

sensitivities.label: Combined Walmart + Amazon net sales (retail customer concentration)
sensitivities.unit: USD million (change in combined Walmart + Amazon net sales)
sensitivities.non_linearity: Coefficient assumes any change in Walmart/Amazon-sourced net sales flows through at the CONSOLIDATED FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin (19.2%) -- no customer-level margin is disclosed. A retailer's shelf-space decision is typically a step function (an assortment cut/add), not a smooth continuous move, so intermediate points on this scale are less reliable than the endpoints actually tested (+/-10% of the combined base) in the markdown §2 table.
sensitivities.source: Derived by agent from FY2025 10-K, Item 1A, p.24 (Walmart ~31%, Amazon ~18% of FY2025 net sales of $1,450.9M; no minimum-purchase commitments at either retailer; Walmart reduced Atkins assortment during FY2025); earnings/01_historical-financials.md §4 (FY2025 Adjusted EBITDA margin 19.2%)

sensitivities.label: Interest rate on $250.0M variable-rate (SOFR-based) term loan
sensitivities.source: FY2025 10-K, Item 7A, p.49: 'a hypothetical 100 basis point increase in interest rates...would increase our annual interest expense by approximately $2.5 million', based on the $250.0 million Term Facility balance outstanding as of August 30, 2025; no interest-rate swaps or caps in place
